name: q-advisor
description: Context advice at turn boundaries: focuses Claude Code's own autocompact on the plan, decisions and changed files, and suggests compacting, clearing for a new task or switching model, with Jev (Haiku fallback) making the judgement calls. Starts in shadow mode.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Optional. Sent only in the Authorization header to api.typesafe.ai. Empty: TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment, else Haiku decides.

mode.title: Advice mode
mode.description: shadow: log every verdict, show no advice. on: show advice at turn boundaries. off: do nothing. /q-advisor on|shadow|off overrides it.

focusCompact.title: Focused autocompact
focusCompact.description: on: when Claude Code compacts on its own, add focus instructions (plan, decisions, changed files, open questions). off: leave autocompact untouched.
